paper.title: Excited Pfaffians: Generalized Neural Wave Functions Across Structure and State
paper.authors: Nicholas Gao, Till Grutschus, Frank Noé, Stephan Günnemann

results.system_description: Li atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 1 down electrons
results.variant: Excited Pfaffian, K = 10 states, one model trained jointly on the atoms Li-Ne
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of the lowest state of the Excited Pfaffian, a set of orthogonal Pfaffian wave functions trained together; each state's energy is its own expectation value, evaluated after training with 10^6 samples (Table of hyperparameters, 'Evaluation'). Multi-state, multi-system training is eligible under P5 (2026-11-02).
results.notes: Sector not printed; the ground term (S = 0 or 1/2) has a single sector with N_up >= N_down. 'We train an Excited Pfaffian on all second-row atoms (Li--Ne) targeting 10 states' (Experiments), snap spin penalty disabled for atoms (Appendix). The error bar's meaning is not stated.

results.system_description: Be atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 2 down electrons
results.variant: Excited Pfaffian, K = 33 states, beryllium only
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of the lowest state of the Excited Pfaffian, a set of orthogonal Pfaffian wave functions trained together; each state's energy is its own expectation value, evaluated after training with 10^6 samples (Table of hyperparameters, 'Evaluation'). Multi-state, training is eligible under P5 (2026-11-02).
results.notes: N_up = N_down = 2, the only sector of the 1S ground term; the 33 states include the 1P and 1D singlets, which exist only at M_S = 0. 'computing all 32 excited states up to the ionization potential' (Experiments). The error bar's meaning is not stated.
